english translation text: IT TOOK A LONG TIME TO DIG ASGHAR'S GRAVE

arabic text: SHAH KO EK CHAND CHUPANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT TOOK A LONG TIME FOR SHAH (THE IMAM) TO BURY A MOON (ASGHAR AS)

arabic text: KUCH QADAM DOOR HAI BAZAAR SE DARBAR MAGAR
english translation text: THE COURT (YAZID'S PALACE) IS JUST A FEW STEPS AWAY FROM THE MARKET BUT

arabic text: PHIR BHI SHEHZADI KO AANE MAY BAHOT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT STILL TOOK A PRINCESS (BIBI ZAINAB AS) A VERY LONG TIME TO ARRIVE (AT THE PALACE)

arabic text: SHAH NE HAR LAASH KO JALDI SE UTHAYA LAYKIN
english translation text: SHAH (IMAM) LIFTED EVERY CORPSE WITH EASE, BUT...

arabic text: LAASH AKBAR KE UTHANAY ME BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT A LONG TIME TO LIFT THE CORPSE OF AKBAR

arabic text: QABR ASGHAR KE BANANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT TOOK A LONG TIME TO DIG ASGHAR'S GRAVE

arabic text: TUKREY CHUNTE HUWE QASIM KE KAHA MAULA NE
english translation text: PICKING UP THE PIECES OF QASIM, OUR MASTER SAID:

arabic text: HAI AFSOS KE AANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: WOE! IT TOOK US TOO LONG TO COME (TO YOUR RESCUE)

arabic text: QABR ASGHAR KE BANANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT TOOK A LONG TIME TO DIG ASGHAR'S GRAVE

arabic text: KIS QADAR PYAS SE SOOKHA THA GULU E SARWAR
english translation text: HOW PARCHED, FROM THIRST, WAS THE NECK OF SARWAR

arabic text: SHIMR KO TAYGH CHALA NE MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT TOOK LONG FOR SHIMR TO SLASH IT WITH THE DAGGER

arabic text: QABR ASGHAR KE BANANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: IT TOOK A LONG TIME TO DIG ASGHAR'S GRAVE

arabic text: KARBALA JAAKE TAKALLUM NE YAHI POOCHA THA
english translation text: UPON REACHING KARBALA, THE ASKER (POET) ASKED

arabic text: MUJH KO SARKAR BULANAY MEI BOHAT DAYR LAGI
english translation text: MASTER, IT TOOK LONG FOR YOU TO INVITE ME
